- Extracts `input_tokens`/`output_tokens` from Gemini's `tokens.input`/`tokens.output` fields
- User content uses the `[]userTextBlock` array format (not raw string `id` field)
- Tool results use `toolResultJSON` struct (consistent with Claude/OpenCode)
- `omitempty` on token fields means they're omitted when zero (same as Claude/OpenCode for messages without usage)
